Getting started
Enable Privacy Display+ in LSPosed and select System Framework and System UI. Return here and tap Soft reboot.

Choose your apps
Open Settings → Display → Privacy display → Conditions for turning on → Apps. Turn on conditions and choose the apps you want to protect.

Window protection
Floating windows and Split screen work independently. Changes apply immediately while the app shows Active. Turning either switch off restores Samsung defaults for that window type. Full-screen apps and other Samsung privacy conditions keep their usual behavior.

App rules
Choose Default, Window only or Full screen separately for each window type. Default follows the switches on the home screen.

Popup handle
Open a floating window’s handle menu and tap the phone-and-shield button. A filled background means protection is on. The choice lasts for that floating session. Other Samsung conditions can still protect the whole screen.

Protect a window
Choose an open floating or split window, even if its app is outside your Samsung list. Temporary protection ends when the window closes, changes window type or Android reloads. Only the main profile is supported.

Soft reboot
Save your work first: running apps will close. This uses the supported KernelSU userspace reload command, with no full-reboot fallback. Grant root access when asked. Other root managers do not support this button.

Compatibility
Support is limited to the firmware listed in the project’s support guide. Recents cards and Picture-in-Picture are not included.
